name: 12 — Performance: 400 Users (Direct Path)
description: Stress test with 400 concurrent users, 3 messages each (1200 total requests). Uses 'mock' profile, NO app, direct path (no Temporal). Tests gateway saturation point. Expected: 100% pass with 3-4s latency. This proves direct path can handle 400+ concurrent users before hitting resource limits.
test_result_ai_analysis:
✅ Grade: A

📊 Result: 400/400 users passed (100%)
⏱️ Latency: 3.8s average
🔧 Path: Direct (no Temporal)
👷 Workers: 0 used

🔍 Findings:
• Stress test PASSED — gateway handled 400 concurrent users!
• Latency still predictable: ~9.5ms per concurrent user
• No failures, no 502 errors
• Infrastructure has headroom

📈 Capacity Estimate:
